routes.name: Free 30-Day Tourist Permit (e-visa)
routes.summary: Apply online before you travel. Approved travelers get a 30-day permit. Single entry. The permit is free but there is a USD 50 online fee.

other: Cover letter, return ticket, accommodation details and proof of funds
Which nationalities qualify is not stated on the page. Check the official portal

routes.name: Visitor Visa (Tourist)
routes.summary: Apply online. Stay up to 3 months per entry, valid 1 year, multiple entries. Extensions possible in country.

other: Return or onward ticket, funds, passport valid 6+ months advised

stay.note: Valid 1 year, multiple entries. The government announcement says total tourist stay up to 180 days.

steps: Register an account on the e-visa portal
Fill in the form and attach documents
Get the grant letter by email and show it on arrival

routes.name: Visa exemptions by agreement (official and some ordinary passports)
routes.summary: Some official, diplomatic and in some cases ordinary passport holders are exempt under deals with the EU, Indonesia, India, the UAE, China and Hong Kong. They still need a support note and sponsor letter.

other: Subject to Gazette notices at time of travel
Full list not confirmed. Check the Immigration Division

routes.name: Business Visa (Short-Term)
routes.summary: Up to 3 months per stay, multiple entries, valid 1 year. No extension.

routes.name: Working Resident Visa (Long-Term Employment)
routes.summary: For people with a long-term job at a company in Solomon Islands. Valid 2 years, multiple entries. Apply from outside the country.

other: Work permit from the Commissioner of Labour

routes.name: Working Resident Visa (Short-Term Employment)
routes.summary: Short-term job route. Valid 6 months, USD 300 per the visa categories page. Details not opened.

routes.name: Student Visa
routes.summary: For students and their dependents. Valid 2 years, extendable.

routes.name: Family Visa (Dependent of Resident or Citizen)
routes.summary: Two routes: dependent of a resident visa holder, or family of a Solomon Islands citizen. Valid up to 2 years, USD 300.

other: Requirements not opened. Check the official page

routes.name: Permanent Resident Visa (Long-Term)
routes.summary: After 5 consecutive years of lawful residence on other visas. Valid 5 years and renewable.

other: Five consecutive years of lawful residence
Valid work permit, police and medical reports, sponsor letter
Character requirements under the Immigration Act 2012
